menu_option_descriptions.hubble: Find cameras through your Hubble account or add compatible cameras by local IP address.
menu_option_descriptions.manual_vm85: Use the Orbweb and RTSP connection details for your own VM85CONNECT.

user.description: Choose how you want to connect your camera.
user.title: Hubble Connected / Motorola

data_description.cloud_login: Use the email from your Hubble app. Leave the email and password blank for local-only setup.
data_description.cloud_camera_ids: If a camera is missing from your account inventory, enter its Hubble registration ID here. Separate multiple IDs with commas.
data_description.local_cameras: Add compatible cameras by name and IP, for example Nursery=192.168.1.50, Office=192.168.1.51. Leave blank if your cameras are discovered automatically.

hubble.description: Sign in to discover your Hubble cameras. If a model 3667 is found, you can set its local IP address in the next step.
hubble.title: Hubble Connected

data_description.orbweb_host: Enter the camera’s private IPv4 address. You can find it in your router’s list of connected devices.
data_description.orbweb_sid: Enter the device-specific SID from your Motorola Nursery session.
data_description.orbweb_password: Enter the Orbweb device password from that same session.
data_description.rtsp_username: Enter the username used to access this camera’s video stream.
data_description.rtsp_password: Enter the password used to access this camera’s video stream.

manual_vm85.description:
Connect your VM85CONNECT to the same local network as Home Assistant. Have the camera’s Orbweb and RTSP details ready.

[VM85CONNECT setup guide]({setup_guide_url})
manual_vm85.title: Motorola VM85CONNECT

data_description.camera_host: Leave blank for automatic discovery. If the local video is missing, enter the camera’s private IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.

camera_lan.description: Link local video to “{camera_name}” so the stream, sensors, and controls appear on the same Home Assistant device.
camera_lan.title: 3667 camera local video

init.description: Update your Hubble account or the list of cameras added manually. You can review the local IP address for each detected 3667 in the next step.
init.title: Hubble cameras

data_description.orbweb_host: Leave blank to keep the saved address. If the camera’s private IPv4 address has changed, enter the new address here.

manual_vm85.description: Update the connection details for this VM85CONNECT. Leave the Orbweb device password and both RTSP fields blank to keep their saved values.
manual_vm85.title: Motorola VM85CONNECT
